title: 집들이
scene: 학습자 원룸 집들이. 다들 휴지와 세제를 들고 왔다

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 야 {name}, 집들이 선물! 휴지 잔뜩 들고 왔어~
turns.rd: ya {name}, jipdeuri seonmul! hyuji jantteuk deulgo wasseo~
turns.en: Hey {name}, housewarming gift! Brought a ton of toilet paper~

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 나는 세제! 거품 팡팡 터지는 걸로 가져왔지
turns.rd: naneun seje! geopum pangpang teojineun geollo gajyeowatji
turns.en: Detergent from me! The kind that bubbles like crazy

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 고마워! 근데 왜 둘 다 휴지랑 세제만 가져왔어?
turns.rd: gomawo! geunde wae dul da hyujirang sejeman gajyeowasseo?
turns.en: Thanks! But why did both of you just bring toilet paper and detergent?

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 아 한국 집들이 국룰이야 안 가져오면 진짜 안 끝나
turns.rd: a hanguk jipdeuri gungnuriya an gajyeoomyeon jinjja an kkeunna
turns.en: Ah, Korean housewarming rule—if you don’t bring it, it literally doesn’t end

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Really? Is there a meaning behind it?

turns.speaker: C
turns.ko: 휴지처럼 잘 풀리고, 거품처럼 돈도 팡팡 불어나라고
turns.rd: hyujicheoreom jal pulligo, geopumcheoreom dondo pangpang bureonarago
turns.en: So things unroll smoothly like tissue, and money multiplies like bubbles

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 헐, 대박이다. 그럼 나 진짜 부자 되겠네
turns.rd: heol, daebagida. geureom na jinjja buja doegenne
turns.en: Whoa, that’s crazy. Then I’m actually gonna get rich

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 그전에 휴지 30롤은 어디다 둘 건데? 원룸인데
turns.rd: geujeone hyuji 30roreun eodida dul geonde? wolluminde
turns.en: First, where are you even putting 30 rolls? It’s a studio
